// Define an array
$numbers = [2,4,6,3,7,9];

// Initialize an empty array to hold the cumulative sum
$cumulative_sum = [];

// Iterate through the array using the for loop with operator
for ($i = 1; $i < count($numbers); $i++){
    $cumulative_sum[$i] = array_sum($numbers) + $cumulative_sum[$i - 1];
}

// Display the result of the cumulative sum
var_dump($cumulative_sum);
